briefdescription.para: Compute the codesize savings for replacing argument A with constant C.
Compute the latency savings from replacing all arguments with constants for a specialization candidate.

detaileddescription.para: As this function computes the latency savings for all Instructions in KnownConstants at once, it should be called only after every instruction has been visited, i.e. after:

listitem.para: getCodeSizeSavingsForArg has been run for every constant argument of a specialization candidate

detaileddescription.para: to ensure that the latency savings are calculated for all Instructions we have visited and found to be constant.
